Controls seat-run on the head: a real minute-grain stamp, a real seconds-grain stamp and the past leap day `2024-02-29` render; `2027-02-29` is refused on both trees (direction rule on main, calendar rule on the head). The header and usage prose now state both grains; the two refusal footers keep the canonical minute spelling (prescription, not description — accepted). Self-test 152 / 9 batteries on main → 186 / 10 on the head (the new battery floored at its measured 34, the battery floor 9 → 10).
- Gates 32 / 32 / 0 / 0 by `--ran`, run twice — on the pre-merge commit and again on the merge commit `6fbb74e8` after `origin/main` moved (the STALE TREE warning noticed, merged, never rebased); the battery 1730 cases pass twice (442.3 s, 437.6 s), exits captured to a file by the detached shell. Five declared deviations, each answered: (1) the positional and mixed refusal TEXTS no longer prescribe a quoted token the tool now refuses — accepted, a refusal prescribing a refused remedy is the file's own stated anti-pattern; refusal kinds unchanged, pinned. (2) the 2028 leap-day control pinned at the rule level, the past leap day end-to-end — accepted, the future one is a direction refusal against the battery clock. (3) `origin/main` merged mid-run and the union re-run — accepted. (4) the footer strings keep the minute spelling — accepted as above. (5) no act-clock token in the report — accepted, the tool cannot classify content. Out of scope, routed: the READ side's `lastWriteStamp` rolls a stored impossible stamp forward and voids a knock in the gap — the header's 「lower bound, never fewer」 promise broken; filed as #18293 (serial behind this PR, reuses its predicate). Register candidates recorded, not filed: on the comment surface the platform's footer normalisation can be byte-non-identical at EQUAL length (this report's read-back) — rides #18280's PR-body/comment footer cells at that dispatch.
